tagline: Read Google Calendar data, run a bounded free/busy query, and safely plan typed Calendar reverse-ETL writes.

global_flags.name: connection
global_flags.summary: Use a saved Google Calendar connector credential.

global_flags.name: credential
global_flags.summary: Alias for selecting a saved connector credential.

global_flags.name: config
global_flags.summary: Inline key=value connector configuration override; do not use for secrets.

global_flags.name: limit
global_flags.summary: Maximum ETL records to read for stream-backed commands.

global_flags.name: plan
global_flags.summary: Execute an approved reverse-ETL plan by id.

global_flags.name: preview
global_flags.summary: Preview a reverse-ETL write command without making a network mutation.

global_flags.name: approval-token-stdin
global_flags.summary: Read the approval token as one bounded line from standard input.

global_flags.name: confirm
global_flags.summary: Typed confirmation challenge for destructive reverse-ETL writes.

commands.summary: List calendars visible in the authenticated user calendar list.
examples: pm google-calendar calendar-list list --json

commands.summary: Read one calendar-list entry using config.calendarid.
examples: pm google-calendar calendar-list get --json

commands.summary: Read configured calendar metadata.
examples: pm google-calendar calendars get --json

commands.summary: Read color palettes for calendars and events.
examples: pm google-calendar colors get --json

commands.summary: List events with updatedMin incremental support.
examples: pm google-calendar events list --json

commands.summary: Read one event using config.calendarid and config.event_id.
examples: pm google-calendar events get --config event_id=event123 --json

commands.summary: List recurring-event instances for config.event_id.
examples: pm google-calendar events instances --config event_id=event123 --json

commands.summary: List user Calendar settings.
examples: pm google-calendar settings list --json

commands.summary: Read one user Calendar setting.
examples: pm google-calendar settings get --config setting=timezone --json

commands.summary: List ACL rules for config.calendarid.
examples: pm google-calendar acl list --json

commands.summary: Read one ACL rule for config.rule_id.
examples: pm google-calendar acl get --config rule_id=default --json

commands.summary: Run a bounded typed free/busy query for one calendar and time range.

constraints.message: time-min must be earlier than time-max

commands.risk: medium
commands.approval: No write approval required; bounded direct read validates typed inputs.
examples: pm google-calendar freebusy query --calendar primary --time-min 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z --time-max 2020-01-02T00:00:00Z --json

commands.summary: Plan deletion of an ACL rule with typed destructive confirmation.
commands.risk: Deletes calendar sharing permission; requires plan, preview, approval, and --confirm destructive.
commands.approval: Plan first, inspect preview output, then execute only with the generated approval token and --confirm destructive.
examples: pm google-calendar acl delete --calendar-id calendar_fixture_1 --rule-id rule_fixture_1 --preview --json

commands.summary: Plan creation of an ACL sharing rule.

flags.name: scope-value
flags.summary: ACL scope value for user, group, or domain scopes.

commands.risk: Grants or changes calendar sharing; requires plan, preview, approval, and execute.
commands.approval: Plan first, inspect preview output, then execute only with the generated approval token.
examples: pm google-calendar acl insert --calendar-id calendar_fixture_1 --role reader --scope-type user --scope-value fixture@example.invalid --preview --json
